fields.climate: varies; equatorial in south, tropical in center, arid in north
fields.terrain: southern lowlands merge into central hills and plateaus; mountains in southeast, plains in north
fields.resources: natural gas, petroleum, tin, iron ore, coal, limestone, niobium, lead, zinc, arable land
fields.farm: cassava, yams, maize, oil palm fruit, rice, taro, bananas, vegetables, sorghum, groundnuts
fields.exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, gold, fertilizers, cocoa beans
fields.industries: crude oil, coal, tin, columbite; rubber products, wood; hides and skins, textiles, cement and other construction materials, food products, footwear, chemicals, fertilizer, printing, ceramics, steel
fields.languages: English (official), Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo (Ibo), Fulani, over 500 additional indigenous languages
fields.religions: Muslim 53.5%, Roman Catholic 10.6%, other Christian 35.3%, other 0.6%
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, Islamic law (in 12 northern states), and traditional law
fields.military: 18-25 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
